legend: Two SNP array profiles of chromosome 21 superimposed on the chromosome 21 ideogram, on which the genomic position of RUNX1 is indicated. The upper profile (black) shows the typical profile of an iAMP21 chromosome showing telomeric loss and the highest region of chromosomal gain encompassing RUNX1. The lower profile (orange) indicates a rare case in which RUNX1 is not included within the highest region of chromosomal gain, although a similar profile with telomeric loss confirms B-lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma with iAMP21.

Interphase FISH showing multiple RUNX1 signals in red and two ETV6 signals in green (<<40890>>). Metaphase cell showing the expected (two) RUNX1 signals on each chromatid of the normal chromosome 21 (upper-left red signals) and the remaining RUNX1 signals clustered together on the iAMP21 chromosome (lower-right red signals) (<<40891>>). Typical SNP array profile of chromosome 21 showing evidence of iAMP21 as illustrated by the alternating copy-number changes across the entire chromosome, in addition to amplification across the RUNX1 locus and terminal copy-number loss (<<40929>>).
